facts.material: plastic (or paper) card printed with a fuse chart
facts.function: identifies the vehicle's fuses by number and description
facts.form: flat printed card attached to the fuse box cover

gri_path: GRI 1: printed information chart is the defining feature; Section VII note 2 sends plastics printed with characters that are not merely subsidiary to their use to chapter 49, except goods of heading 3918 or 3919
Heading 4911 other printed matter; not paper-lithographed matter of 4911.99.60 if printed on plastic
If the card has a self-adhesive back it stays in 3919 (excepted from Section VII note 2), 3919.90.50.60

rejected_alternatives.reason: self-adhesive plastic flat shapes; applies only if the card has a pressure-sensitive adhesive back, which is not stated (F83391 used this line for the adhesive version)
not a part of switching/protecting apparatus; the card is only an information label
applies only to matter printed on paper by lithography; fuse cards are typically plastic

missing_facts: Does the card have a self-adhesive back (3919.90.50.60) or not (4911.99.80.00)?
Is the substrate plastic or paper, and if paper, is it printed lithographically (4911.99.60.00)?
classification.rationale: NY F83391 (in force) classified printed motor vehicle fuse cards carrying a fuse chart: the self-adhesive plastic card in 3919.90.50.60 and the non-adhesive card as other printed matter in 4911.99.80. The description does not say whether the cards are self-adhesive, which decides the heading. The best guess is the non-adhesive printed matter line 4911.99.80.00, since Section VII note 2 sends printed plastics other than 3918/3919 goods to chapter 49.
